title: Lively Malty Irish Mushroom Skillet
description: A hearty and adventurous Irish dish featuring malty flavors, crumbly textures, and sautéed mushrooms, all cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet. This Whole30-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the malt vinegar, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until wilted.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
